name: latex-math
description: Typesets the LaTeX math in Claude's replies as images in the terminal, through the kitty graphics protocol. Chinese and Japanese text in formulas is typeset too.

images.title: Typeset math as images
images.description: auto, on or off. auto draws pictures in kitty and Ghostty and writes Unicode text in other terminals. on draws pictures in a terminal that the plugin does not recognise. off always writes Unicode text. Inside tmux or screen, Claude Code draws no pictures.

inline.title: Inline math
inline.description: image or unicode. image draws inline math ($...$) as one-row pictures inside the line. unicode writes it as Unicode text.

promptSection.title: Tell Claude that math is typeset
promptSection.description: Adds one short section to the system prompt, so Claude writes formulas in LaTeX. It is added only when pictures are on.

scale.title: Size of display math
scale.description: A multiple of the default size, from 0.5 to 2.

weight.title: Weight of formulas
weight.description: normal or bold. bold sets every formula in the bold math fonts, whose heavier strokes are easier to read on a dark background.

cellAspect.title: Cell aspect of the terminal
cellAspect.description: The height of a terminal cell over its width, from 1 to 3. A picture made for another aspect is drawn stretched or squeezed. Noto Sans Mono, for one, has cells of 1 by 2.27.

cjkFont.title: Font for Chinese in formulas
cjkFont.description: auto, none or the name of a system font. auto is PingFang SC on macOS and the Arphic font gbsn elsewhere; none is always gbsn. A system font needs xelatex and pdftocairo.

cjkStretch.title: Width of Chinese in formulas
cjkStretch.description: Widens the Chinese characters set in a system font, from 0.5 to 2. In a terminal that draws pictures taller than they are, it keeps them square: the default 1.135 is for cells of 1 by 2.27 at a cell aspect of 2, and 1 is for cells of 1 by 2.

cjkScale.title: Size of Chinese in formulas
cjkScale.description: The size of the Chinese characters set in a system font, from 0.5 to 2, to match the terminal's own Chinese text.

cacheSizeMB.title: Picture cache limit in MB
cacheSizeMB.description: When a session starts, the least recently used pictures are deleted until the cache is under this size.
